The '''690s BBY''' or '''690s<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Before the Battle of Yavin'''<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> was a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]]<ref name="TEGtW" /> of the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]]<ref name="NEC" /> that fell within the [[Great Peace of the Republic]].<ref name="Great Peace">{{CSWECite|I|363|Great Peace of the Republic}} establishes that the [[Great Peace of the Republic]] lasted between the [[Ruusan campaign]] and the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|beginning]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], respectively.</ref> During that period of [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] played a key role in the conflict known as the [[Battles of the Black Delve]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The 690s BBY were introduced in [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]'s [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''.<ref name="TEGtW" />
